Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Off Calendar Jun-17-2010 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 218, Comm. William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Arlene Howell, #2542.

Elizabeth MacDonald, Esq. appeared for plaintiff American Express Centurion Bank.
No appearance by defendant Ziad Hamadalla, an individual.
Default was entered against defendant on January 4, 2010.
Doe defendants were dismissed on January 8, 2010.
Order waiving witness appearance at default prove-up hearing was filed on June 15, 2010.

After hearing the evidence presented, and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of Plaintiff American Express Centurion Bank, and against the Defaulted Defendant Ziad Hamadalla, an individual as follows:

Damages/Principal - $28,763.47.
Prejudgment Interest - $2,285.31.
Attorney's Fees - Reserved.
Costs - $463.00.

Total - $31,511.78.

Judgment was submitted to and signed by the Court.
